LanguageData.MAP_MechanoidMechanitor.Symbiosis.Allian: Our own strength may not be enough to end the cerebrex's threat. We can broadcast a "Public secession declaration" through the comms console, make our position clear to other factions, gradually earn their trust, and invite them to oppose the cerebrex together.\n\nOur connection to the mechanoid hive has not been restored, and the hive does not yet consider us enemies. Once it receives this declaration, however, we will become fully hostile to it. Before making our position public, we should secure our base and prepare for raids.
LanguageData.MAP_MechanoidMechanitor.Symbiosis.TrustG:
We have publicly declared our secession from the cerebrex. Other factions no longer see us simply as hostile mechanoids, but they remain uncertain about our true intentions.

We can now gradually earn each faction's trust through our actions. When a faction's trust in us reaches 25, we can use the comms console to invite it to join the "Symbiosis covenant".

Trust can be increased in the following ways:

Trading, completing faction quests, clearing mechanoid hive nodes, and taking other actions that improve goodwill with the corresponding faction.

Note: Trust gained through trade and goodwill improvements is capped within a given period. To earn other factions' trust more quickly, we need to demonstrate our commitment through concrete actions.
LanguageData.MAP_MechanoidMechanitor.Symbiosis.Covena:
The "Symbiosis covenant" has been officially formed. Its members are willing to set aside their doubts for now and try a different way of working together.

From now on, the covenant will have a shared unity score. Unity represents the covenant's overall cohesion and determines how far it can develop.

Factions that have formally joined the covenant contribute daily unity based on their trust in us. Once a member's trust exceeds 50, higher trust means a greater daily unity contribution; excessively low trust will weaken the covenant's unity.

In addition, successful joint military operations and other forms of covenant cooperation can directly increase unity.

As unity grows, the covenant will gradually unlock deeper forms of cooperation. Try to maintain trust among its members: this is the foundation of a lasting covenant.
LanguageData.MAP_MechanoidMechanitor.Symbiosis.Contac: The Symbiosis covenant can be accessed through the comms console. Improve relations with other factions, build trust, and invite them to form a covenant against the cerebrex.
LanguageData.MAP_MechanoidMechanitor.Symbiosis.Title: Symbiosis covenant // Multilateral coordination link
LanguageData.MAP_MechanoidMechanitor.Symbiosis.Subtit: Symbiosis covenant online. View covenant members, unity, and secession declaration status.
LanguageData.MAP_MechanoidMechanitor.Symbiosis.Declar: Not yet publicly seceded from the cerebrex

We are about to broadcast a secession declaration worldwide, informing other factions that we have broken free of the mechanoid hive's control and are determined to resist it to the end. The hive will also receive this message and mark us as anomalous rogue units. We will face retaliation from the mechanoid hive.\n\nShall we proceed?
